title: Learning AI Agents, Market Makers, and Stress in Automated Markets
abstract: arXiv:2611.01799v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated markets increasingly route order flow from learning trading agents through automated market makers (AMMs). We model trader archetypes as AI agents defined by their reward functions and analyze the feedback they create on a constant-product AMM. Herd-dominated and arbitrage-dominated markets of equal size have identical return distributions and turnover, so no rule based on volatility, value-at-risk, stress frequency, or volume can tell them apart; yet their stress episodes differ in length by a factor unbounded in the feedback-to-noise ratio $\beta/s$. Serial statistics identify the feedback sign from $\Theta((s/\beta)^2\log(1/\delta))$ observations, and this rate is tight. When agents trade together, profit-seeking agents ride herds rather than lean against them, leading to all-or-nothing participation. Spread-earning market makers restore stability but make liquidity fragile, with discontinuous collapse and hysteresis; maker-

translated_title: 学习型AI智能体、做市商与自动化市场中的压力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.01799v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：自动化市场日益增多的将来自学习型交易智能体的订单流引导至自动做市商（AMM）。我们将交易者原型建模为由其奖励函数定义的AI智能体，并分析它们在恒定乘积AMM上产生的反馈效应。在相同规模下，羊群主导的市场与套利主导的市场具有完全相同的收益分布和换手率，因此任何基于波动率、风险价值（VaR）、压力频率或交易量的规则都无法区分它们；然而，两者的压力事件持续时间在反馈噪声比 β/s 下相差一个无界倍数。利用序列统计量可以从 Θ((s/β)²log(1/δ)) 次观测中识别反馈的符号，且该速率是紧的（最优的）。当各类智能体共同交易时，追求利润的智能体倾向于跟随羊群而非逆势对冲，从而导致全有或全无式的参与行为。赚取价差的做市商能够恢复市场稳定性，但会使流动性变得脆弱，表现为不连续的崩塌与滞后效应……
tldr: 该论文将交易者建模为AI智能体，证明了恒定乘积AMM上羊群主导与套利主导的市场在收益分布等常规统计指标上不可区分、但在压力持续时间和反馈结构上存在本质差异，并给出了识别反馈符号的最优样本复杂度，同时揭示价差型做市商虽能稳定市场却导致流动性脆弱。
en_tdlr: By modeling traders as AI agents on a constant-product AMM, this paper proves that herd- and arbitrage-dominated markets are statistically indistinguishable by standard risk metrics yet differ unboundedly in stress-episode length, establishes a tight sample complexity for identifying the feedback sign from serial statistics, and shows that spread-earning market makers restore stability while making liquidity fragile.
